gloss: two rounds; two sizes (bigger/smaller); 24 years apart in the zodiac

definitions.gloss: two sizes (bigger or smaller); much larger/smaller
definitions.explanation: Used to describe a noticeable difference in size, typically saying something is two sizes bigger or smaller than expected or than something else.

definitions.gloss: two cycles of the zodiac; 24 years apart
definitions.explanation: In the Chinese zodiac system, one cycle is 12 years. Two cycles means a 24-year age difference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: He's two sizes bigger than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I became two sizes smaller from dieting.

examples.japanese: {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought shoes two sizes too big.

examples.japanese: {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{干支|えと}→干支：12449_eto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If there's a two-cycle difference, you have the same zodiac sign.

examples.japanese: {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I'm working with a junior colleague who is 24 years younger.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in everyday speech when comparing sizes. Sense 2 relates to the ⟦{干支|えと}→干支：12449_eto⟧ (Chinese zodiac), where one full cycle is 12 years. Compare with ⟦{一回|ひとまわ}り→一回り：11235_hitomawari⟧ (one size; 12 years apart).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (two sizes bigger)
- {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ (two sizes smaller)
- {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧ (24 years older)
- {二回|ふたまわ}り⟦{年下|としした}→年下：07303_toshishita⟧ (24 years younger)
